scheme_name: Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme for the Students Who Attain First Position in CBSE Annual Exams in the State
other_conditions: Top‑ranked boy or girl in CBSE Class 10th or 12th state‑level examinations
Must be a regular student continuing education
Must have passed from a school in Haryana
For Class 10, must have secured at least 92 % in English, Science & Technology, Mathematics, Social Science and the best one of the remaining subjects
For Class 12, must have secured at least 90 % in English and the four best subjects in Science (Medical & Non‑Medical), Commerce or Humanities
Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID) is mandatory for availing any scholarship benefit
benefits_summary: Financial incentive covering full tuition fees up to ₹25,000 per year for 10th‑class toppers and up to ₹1,00,000 per year for 12th‑class toppers, payable annually until graduation.
